comment: Sidechain compressor: compresses L using R as its detector. Output modes are Sum (weighted compressed L + R to both outputs), Parallel (separate weighted compressed L and R), and Comp L (weighted compressed L to both outputs). Includes five compressor-inspired responses and a live 0-24 dB gain-reduction needle meter. Intended for MS-70CDR 2.10 at 44.1 kHz.

params.name: Thrs
params.comment: Sidechain threshold, approximately -80 dBFS to -12 dBFS.

params.name: Rat
params.comment: Compression from 1:1 to 100:1; the maximum position hard-mutes the compressed signal when the sidechain reaches twice Threshold.

params.name: Make
params.comment: Post-compression makeup gain from 0 to approximately +24 dB for stronger pumping.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: Stepped output routing: Sum (weighted L + R to both), Parallel (separate L and R), or Comp L (compressed L to both).

params.name: LLev
params.comment: Output level for compressed L (and its contribution in Sum), 0 to 4x.

params.name: RLev
params.comment: Output level for the R sidechain (Sum and Parallel), 0 to 4x.
